remarks: Nestled on a coveted cul-de-sac in North Stamford's sought-after Wildwood Association, this spacious Colonial offers a perfect blend of privacy and comfort. Set on over an acre and backing to serene wooded land, this 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home is designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. With hardwood floors throughout, the living room features a classic wood-burning fireplace and family room showcases a stunning wall of custom built-ins. The eat-in kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining room and opens to your new favorite space-a sun-drenched 3-season porch overlooking the peaceful yard. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a walk-in closet & a spacious en-suite bath. 3 additional bedrooms & full bath complete the 2nd level. The newly refinished walk-out lower level adds exceptional versatility, featuring a full bath, expansive rec/playroom, and flex space ideal for a home office, gym, or potential 5th bedroom. Outdoor living is just as inviting, with a charming front porch, a new composite deck, & a private patio perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Recent upgrades: a fully renovated basement, updated electrical panel, new hot water heater, new well tank and injection pump, new second-floor A/C unit, & freshly painted exterior-providing peace of mind for years to come. Conveniently located with easy access to Greenwich, New Canaan, & Bedford, this home offers both tranquility and accessibility. HIGHEST AND BEST OFFERS DUE 3/30 AT 2PM.
